visualCharacteristics: Row of 4 compact quick-action tiles on a light background (1 col mobile, 2 at 600px, 4 at 900px). Each tile: small icon, a bold blue title link (e.g. 'Manage my policy >'), and a short supporting sentence.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = optional icon cell + body cell (title link + short description).
usage: Quick-action shortcut rows inside the self-serve tab panels.
